versions.changelog:
Energy Audit skill v1.0.0 — initial release for commercial building assessments.

- Runs comprehensive energy audits for commercial and industrial facilities
- Benchmarks energy use, identifies top 10 energy-saving measures, and calculates payback, IRR, and lifecycle cost
- Generates ASHRAE Level II audit report with actionable retrofit roadmap and executive summary
- Highlights utility rate optimization and available rebates or incentives by location
- Designed for user-friendly agent interactions using real utility data and facility details
